title: Frequency Fence Trimming
description:
## Task

Delete as few characters as possible from `s` so that no two different letters that remain appear the same number of times. A letter may be deleted completely; a letter that is gone no longer counts. You choose which characters to delete.

## Input

- `s` — a string of lowercase letters. It may be empty.

## Output

The smallest number of characters that must be deleted.

## Example

```python
min_deletions_unique_freq("aaabbbcc")  # returns 2
min_deletions_unique_freq("abc")  # returns 2
min_deletions_unique_freq("aab")  # returns 0
```

## Constraints

- 0 ≤ length of `s` ≤ 10^5
- `s` contains only the lowercase letters `a`-`z`.
